name: Etowah County, AL
findings: Etowah County has 266 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Etowah County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Etowah County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list volunteering
observations.text: No religious organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 31 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 8 professional organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do professional organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
